Resolves #21748

`examples/scheduler/liveUpdates` drops the four `--neo-timeline-gridline-step` declarations it set by hand (270 px, and 180 px when compact, on the viewport and on its tracks). Since #21740 the column writes the step inline on every track, which beats them, and the track's gradient is the property's only reader, so nothing on screen changes. `Gridlines.spec.mjs` now measures this example beside the other five.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e: the step equals the header's tick at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844) → L3 required (the example's gridlines). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — four dead declarations removed and one example added to an existing spec's list.
